record.question: In mineral deposit, a final class of hydrothermal deposit is called
record.explanation: Stratiform deposits have ore distributed in layers conformable with the enclosing strata, and can form by precipitation from hydrothermal fluids into sedimentary basins. This is the stratiform class referred to in the question; USGS describes stratiform exhalative deposits precipitated from hydrothermal fluids (https://www.usgs.gov/publications/volcanogenic-massive-sulfide-occurrence-model). The printed page 2 confirms the stem and option order.
